mapper.select: SELECT A.CODE_ID, A.CODE_ID_NM, A.CODE_ID_DC, A.USE_AT, A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM COMTCCMMNCODE A WHERE A.CL_CODE = 'COMPASS' AND A.USE_AT = 'Y'
SELECT A.CL_CODE, A.CODE_ID, A.CODE_ID_NM, A.CODE_ID_DC, A.USE_AT, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM COMTCCMMNCODE A WHERE A.CODE_ID = #{codeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE COMTCCMMNCODE SET CODE_ID_NM = #{codeIdNm}, CODE_ID_DC = #{codeIdDc}, USE_AT = #{useAt}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{userId}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = NOW() WHERE CODE_ID = #{codeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE WHERE CODE_ID = #{codeId}; DELETE FROM COMTCCMMNCODE WHERE CODE_ID = #{codeId};
